The [[Imperial Dragon Sword]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] obtained from [[Azume]] in [[Kaineng Center]] after completion of [[The Final Confrontation]] in exchange for a [[Imperial Dragon's Tear]].

==Stats==
: [[Lightning Dmg]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Sword Mastery]])
: Damage +15% (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]]) 
: [[Health]] +30

==Replica==
Including the visual appearance, an exact technical replica can be produced with:
*An [[Imperial Sword]] from [[Shen Xi]]
*A [[Shocking]] sword hilt.
*A sword pommel [[of Fortitude]].
*A [[Inscription#Combat_enhancing|"Guided by Fate"]] inscription.
